page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The hardware deployment provides 24 vCPUs mapped across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, running on an x86_64 architecture using a KVM hypervisor. Memory capacity is configured at 96.0 GB of RAM, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The processor instruction set includes support for AVX-512 vector extensions, BMI2, and AES cryptographic acceleration. Network connectivity features an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance does not include local disk storage or attached GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks show average overall throughput for multi-core and system-level operations alongside modest single-core execution capacity. PassMark testing yields a CPU score of 18,227.84, while Geekbench records a multi-core score of 7,786.0 and a single-core score of 1,008.0. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 90.15 GB/sec, with write performance reaching 50.79 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates 16.81 million operations per second in Redis SET tasks, 13.07 GB/sec static web serving throughput, and prompt processing speeds of 30.14 tokens per second on 7B parameter language models.

The ecs.g5.6xlarge presents a standard general-purpose profile where compute and memory resources are balanced for parallelized software. Because single-threaded benchmark results remain in lower performance percentiles, workload scaling relies primarily on multi-core utilization. The absence of ephemeral local storage requires reliance on network-attached block volumes. This server configuration is best suited for multi-threaded application servers, relational database management, container orchestration nodes, static web hosting, and software compilation tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs, 12 physical cores, and 96.0 GB of RAM, it maintains a standard 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio suitable for broad enterprise applications. The instance features an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operates on a KVM hypervisor, and supports instruction sets including AVX-512 and AES. It includes no bundled local SSD storage or GPU acceleration. Benchmark evaluations show average multi-core CPU execution, memory bandwidth, and database performance alongside lower single-core processing speeds. The ecs.g5.6xlarge instance provides balanced resource density for multi-threaded backend services, static web serving, container management, and software build pipelines requiring moderate system memory.
